Welcome to SCOT-Web Demo with Cats

This page demonstrates the capabilities of the SCOT-Web system, now enriched with adorable cat content and interactive media elements.

System Core Features

Our system generates structured, styled, and interactive web pages with ease. Here are its key strengths:

Semantic HTML

Uses meaningful tags for better structure and accessibility.

Flexible Layouts

Implements modern CSS (Flexbox & Grid) for responsive design.

Interactive Forms

Builds user-friendly forms with validation and styling.

Media Integration

Easily incorporates images, audio, and video elements.
